name: Asa M. Hyde
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in White Plains, New York
about: Asa M. Hyde is a partner at Kitson, Haffner & Hyde, LLP, located in White Plains, New York, where he advises individuals and families in matters involving family law and estate planning. His practice focuses on helping clients manage emotionally and legally complex situations – ranging from divorce and custody issues to the thoughtful preparation of end-of-life directives.

Mr. Hyde earned his bachelor’s degree from Hampshire College and went on to receive his law degree from Fordham University School of Law. While at Fordham, he distinguished himself as a Ruth Whitehead Whaley Scholar and contributed as an associate editor to the Fordham Intellectual Property, Media and Entertainment Law Journal. His academic background reflects both intellectual rigor and a dedication to legal scholarship.

Drawing from his deep commitment to advocacy and client-centered counsel, Mr. Hyde approaches each case with empathy, diligence and strategic insight. In family and matrimonial matters, he works closely with clients to help them understand their options and achieve favorable outcomes with minimal disruption. His aim is always to empower clients through clear communication and personalized legal solutions.

In addition to his work in family law, Mr. Hyde advises clients on estate matters, helping them plan for the future by drafting wills, health care proxies, powers of attorney and related documents. His estate practice also includes the administration of estates, guiding executors and beneficiaries through probate proceedings with care and efficiency.

Mr. Hyde is admitted to practice in New York and is a member of the New York City Bar Association. He continues to be driven by a strong belief in the value of responsive and principled legal representation, particularly in moments that require both legal precision and human understanding.
